items.title: AppSettings.qaOtpEnabled=true on the connected database would accept 0000/000000 for any account
items.reproduction: isQaOtpEnabled() returned true with empty QA_OTP_CODE because settings.qaOtpEnabled was true. matchesQaPhoneOtp('0000') would succeed in non-production. If the same row is read by a production NODE_ENV process, it was production-reachable before the code gate.
items.rootCause: QA master OTP honored AppSettings without a production NODE_ENV hard stop.
